method: Geothermal intensity for a station without its own figure, in order: (1) source-specific figure for that station and year. A publisher's stated intensity is a step-1 source and outranks any derived value; where two source-specific figures exist, the most recent measured period wins (tie-break). (2) the same station's nearest published year; (3) nearest station on the same field; (4) NZGA fleet average (MW-weighted). Clause (a): never derive an intensity from metered export; derive only where no stated intensity exists, and only with the operator's own generation figure. Clause (b): a period the operator identifies as outage-affected, or as commissioning or ramp-up, is not carried forward into the projection. Applied 2025: Contact FY25 stated (Tauhara, Te Mihi, Wairakei, Poihipi, Te Huka, Te Huka 3) and Mercury FY25 stated (GHG Inventory FY2025 p19 Figure 3: Kawerau 104.7, Nga Awa Purua 51.0, Rotokawa 54.2, Nga Tamariki 27.3, Mokai 18.6). Clause (b) keeps CY2024 in the projection for Nga Awa Purua and Rotokawa (Mercury Interim Report 2025 p5), Te Mihi, Wairakei and Te Huka (Contact FY25/HY25 results presentations, Integrated Report 2025 p56) and Tauhara (commissioning and ramp-up 1H25); Te Huka 3 follows Te Huka (step 3). Every value from steps 2 to 4 is flagged. Steps 2 and 4 are applied in fuel_attribution.py; step 3 is a GEO_MAP_ row
source: Decisions 2026-09-29 (revised order; stated intensities outrank derived; clauses (a) and (b) revised)
